acceptanceCriteria: One selected command-family parameter change is reflected in CLI behavior, the machine description, MCP schema, and the generated reference facts without editing separate copies of the same interface fact.
The description exposes stable names, types, requiredness, defaults, enumerations, schema version, and Runtime version; its values agree with actual parsing and MCP validation.

Two consecutive generations are byte-identical, deterministic without network/time/machine paths, and preserve human-authored explanation outside a marked generated region in English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese.

Agent guidance and managed adapter checks distinguish current, owned-old, user-modified, and unknown-ownership states; doctor is read-only, updates are ownership-safe, and repeated install/update is idempotent.
Description and documentation validation do not start verification subprocesses, scan Work Item history, infer permissions, or alter lifecycle, authorization, Outcome, or receipt semantics.
Existing amendment, events, task report, and Outcome records remain the handoff source; no parallel handoff log or receipt system is introduced.

The final Outcome records before/after maintenance locations, operation steps, verification commands, measured durations, resolved limits, and unknown benefits without claiming unmeasured improvement.
goal: For one selected command-family trial, maintain interface facts once, expose deterministic machine and human descriptions through existing CLI/MCP discovery paths, keep embedded Agent guidance ownership-safe and version-consistent, and prove reduced duplicate maintenance without changing lifecycle or Outcome delivery behavior.
intent: Reduce AI Cockpit interface-documentation and Agent-operation cost by using a shared deterministic description projection for one command-family trial, embedded guidance consistency checks, and existing handoff records without changing governance semantics.
outOfScope: BAML as a dependency or runtime
full documentation migration or wholesale translation rewrite

scenarioCoverage.expected: The selected work-item outcome parameter facts, defaults, enum values, and requiredness are emitted from the declared shared description projection and agree with actual CLI parsing and MCP schema behavior.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run focused CLI and MCP parity tests against valid and invalid outcome arguments, including summary/full defaults, language values, delivery, and alias requirements.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Two description/reference generations are byte-identical and update only a marked generated interface-fact region while preserving human-authored explanation in all three languages.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the generator twice in an isolated fixture, compare digests, and run the tri-language documentation checks.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Embedded guidance, managed adapter content, install, doctor, old-version detection, user modification detection, and idempotent update retain ownership-safe behavior.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run cockpit-agent install and doctor tests for current, stale-but-owned, modified, and repeated-install states.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Interface description and documentation validation do not scan Work Item history or start verification subprocesses.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run command-level tests with subprocess and repository-observation counters asserted at zero.
